## Workload

Elif Sahin graded 715 sets during 418 rostered hours. This represents an average output of 1.7 per hour. The workload and recorded rate are noted for review in the quarterly grading assessment. These figures provide the basis for considering the volume completed against the hours available.

## Quality

A total of 49 sets were read again as part of the quality review. The recorded agreement was 71.4 per cent. This result is documented alongside the workload information to provide a concise view of grading activity and quality outcomes. No further action is required this quarter.

The review was completed by Priya Anand.
